University of Maine real-time buoy observations in the Gulf of Maine at NERACOOS site A01 - Massachusetts Bay, located at 42d 31.338m N, 70d 33.912m W, SE of Gloucester. GoMOOS buoy A0108 was deployed from 2004-03-22 12:10:00 until 2004-05-14 16:30:00 UTC.  Oceanographic near-surface measurements of temperature, conductivity,salinity, and density at a depth of 1 meter were taken hourly.
